permissions.name: dsh-recency-guard.fs.read
permissions.reason: Read the profile package.json, node_modules metadata/mtimes, plugin-declared dshCompat / dsh-plugin.json compatibility manifests, the existing cordis.patch.yml and the config-editor snapshot to rank suspects, emit conflict findings and validate guarded rows before writing.

permissions.name: dsh-recency-guard.fs.write
permissions.reason: Append guarded rows to the profile cordis.patch.yml, persist guard state under <profile>/.recency-guard (journal/state/decision/backups/archive/rescue records), and, only on explicit --yes, let the offline rescue CLI remove or reinsert bundle entries in the profile package.json.

permissions.name: dsh-recency-guard.process.probe
permissions.reason: Probe the previous host pid with process.kill(pid, 0) so a SIGKILL or power loss, which never runs exit handlers, is detected as a second crash channel.

permissions.name: dsh-recency-guard.http.panel
permissions.reason: Register the management panel's local HTTP data surface (GET reads, POST actions) on the host webServer under /recency-guard/api.
